name: parcel-shelf
prompt: A notice tells me folded posters are on the top shelf, rolled posters on the bottom shelf and tubes on the middle shelf. Where should I look for a rolled poster?

name: counter-reset
prompt: The counter showed 12 entries before it was reset and 5 afterward. It counted every entry over the shift. We didn't record anyone's identity. What can I report about the total entries and the number of distinct visitors?

name: programme-change
prompt: Our programme listed the talk in Room Grey, which you flagged under **f8**. Staff verified it has been corrected to Room Lime. You also just learned the interpreter will join by video. Please send me a status update I can refer to by item.

name: sign-copy
prompt: Draft a small sign for visitors returning borrowed bags. They should empty the bag first so staff don’t find loose items, then hang it on a hook so the aisle stays clear. Give me the wording I can print.
